newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain arrests suspects for arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain arrests suspects for arson attack.

text.p: Bahrain has detained a number of suspects in connection with an arson attack which damaged stores four days ago, newspapers said on Thursday.
They quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying the blaze took place on Sunday night and damaged two Hamad Town Co-operative Society stores and a nearby shop which sells soft drinks.
"Investigations have revealed that the fire was started deliberately...Inquiries are continuing and the suspects are being held in detention," the Gulf Daily News newspaper said.
The Interior Ministry statement did not say how many people had been detained.

Members of the Gulf Arab island's majority Shi'ite Moslem community have waged sporadic protests, arson attacks and violence in the past two years to demand political and economic reforms from the Sunni-led government.
At least 28 people have been killed and hundreds have been detained since the unrest began in December 1994.
